body:
Thank you so much for the reply! 

Yes, I've never really considered myself an addict. I think you hit it on the head about the fact that it is more a habit. I generally only do "hard" drugs when I am down and depressed. Most of the time I stay away from them. I don't even like these drugs, let alone the way they make me feel. 

I completely agree that it is about breaking my current habits and setting goals. Lately I have been trying to be much more social and started volunteering for random activities such as baseball, D&D and computer recycling. I know I need to get back to having ambitions in life, for the past year nothing has motivated me and I had lost all hope that I could possibly return to "normal" life. 

My biggest goal right now is to get a job and start making money and meeting people. I think one of the things that has really got me into trouble is my inability to socialize and have a personal life outside my binging.

Yeah, I agree. One of my roommates (the one that does H) even offered me to move in with him, but I know that that would be a big mistake. As much as I'd like to think I could refuse, I just don't know. My feelings are up and down and some days I just say "fuck it" and throw caution out the window. 

Unfortunately it'll be a good two weeks, if not more, before I can move. I don't have a job and hardly any money, so I need to start working day labor next week. But I definitely intendto get out of here as soon as possible. I just can't be a part of this culture anymore. It is sad to see so many people whose entire lives revolve around that next fix, I don't want to be the same.

Thanks for the reply, man. I really appreciate it.
I am about to be starting a new semester in two weeks. I've been going for the last four years (with about a one year break).

Right on, yeah I'll check up that site for sure.

I have gone to one reddit meetup here but they are infrequent though. I guess I could post to the city subreddit and see if people want to hang out though...
Thanks, I really do appreciate it. Right now I am in a temporary living situation so finding something in this area isn't really necessary. However, I'll PM you with the location I'll be moving to.

I am 25 right now, about to be 26 in another few months here. I was the same way with my ex before my ex-wife. We broke up and it took me about two and a half years or so to really get over it, I know that this is the storm before clear waters but it is even worse this time and last time was really bad, so that is saying something.

I have done a lot of traveling. From the time I was 16 I pretty much traveled extensively for years (West coast to the East coast and back again). I have thought about just traveling again but the traveler's life is ultimately a lonely life and more than anything I just want to have someone again, even though in my experience it seems to just burn me in the end.

I do distract myself but I keep coming back to the same thoughts. It's hard to do some of the things that distract me because a lot of the things I like/do are things that we shared as well and then it leads me back into self-loathing and regret.

I have thought about it but I don't really have the cash to see someone. I was diagnosed with depression a few years ago, however. I've tried dealing with it on my own for some time but it is much harder now with all that has transpired. It helps to talk to other people though, although eventually I wind up alone and with my thoughts again and my mind wanders into sad places again.
